vision: Transform India into the global leader in XR-powered learning infrastructure, making immersive education accessible to every student regardless of geography, language, or economic background — then scale this model worldwide.
mission: Reduce training time by 40% and increase knowledge retention by 75% through AI-powered immersive XR experiences that work on any device, in any language, even offline.

usp.noCodeXR: No-code XR content creation platform — teachers create immersive lessons without coding or 3D design skills
usp.webXR: WebXR-first architecture — runs on any browser, no headset dependency, no app downloads for students
usp.vernacularLearning: Vernacular learning in 12+ Indian languages with AI-powered speech and text localization
usp.offlineCapability: Offline-first PWA with local caching — works in rural areas with zero or intermittent connectivity
usp.governmentReady: Government-compliant deployment: data residency in India, STQC-ready, NIC integration compatible, GIGW accessible
usp.aiPowered: AI-generated 3D environments, auto-assessment, adaptive learning paths, and real-time analytics

targets: Rajasthan Govt — RSLDC (Rajasthan Skill & Livelihoods Development Corp)
Rajasthan DoIT&C (Dept of Information Technology & Communication)

b2b.description: Schools, coaching institutes, universities — XR Labs + SaaS licensing

b2c.description: LearnXR App direct subscription for students
b2c.targetUsers: Class 6-12 students, competitive exam aspirants, skill learners

northStarGoal.description: Secure Government + Institutional XR contracts and scale to ₹40Cr+ revenue in 5 years
keyMilestones: Y1: 3 govt pilots signed, 10 schools onboarded, ₹32L revenue
Y2: Rajasthan state-wide deployment started, 50 schools, ₹1.8Cr revenue
Y3: 2 additional states, 200 schools, B2C app at 10K MAU, ₹8.5Cr revenue
Y4: National presence (5 states), 400 schools, 50K MAU, ₹22Cr revenue
Y5: 8+ states, international pilot, 500+ schools, 100K+ MAU, ₹43Cr revenue
